additional_candidates.name: Jornada automated shallow moisture, M-RABB
additional_candidates.evidence: USDA catalog metadata inspected with browser; 30-minute observations at 10, 20 and 30 cm. Exact downloadable version not pinned.

additional_candidates.name: Jornada automated shallow moisture, M-NORT
additional_candidates.evidence: USDA catalog metadata inspected with browser; daily averages at 10, 20 and 30 cm. Exact downloadable version not pinned.

additional_candidates.name: Rainfall variability biomass
additional_candidates.evidence: Primary paper and Jornada annual report identify experiment; requested EML version5 returned404 through DataONE mirror. Paired water EML version6 obtained.

additional_candidates.name: AmeriFlux US-Jo1 and US-Jo2
additional_candidates.evidence: Official site-search inventory inspected; BASE observation spans listed as 2010-2022 and 2010-2020 respectively, CC-BY-4.0. No observation download.

additional_candidates.name: Jornada 2022 mesquite/creosote sap flow
additional_candidates.evidence: Author preprint describes June-October2022 measurements; no public raw sap-flow archive verified.

additional_candidates.name: Jornada shrub cover rasters
additional_candidates.evidence: Primary methods paper inspected. Referenced raster archive title says2011; paper also analyzes2009/2016 imagery. Exact imagery/files must be reconciled; no raster downloaded.

additional_candidates.name: Historical Jornada grassland biomass
additional_candidates.evidence: Official ORNL inventory lists NPP Grassland: Jornada, USA,1970-1972,R1. Landing/guide retrieval failed; supplemental lead only, not qualified.

access_note: DataONE mirrors can lag EDI. Pinned inspected versions are not represented as latest versions. Empty HTTP200 body for requested biomass v4 is a failed retrieval.
